correctness.rationale: The rank decomposition of 2x2 idempotents is exhaustive in every characteristic. For trace-one targets, ordered complementary lines determine all rank-one projections. The determinant of the residual is zero exactly when its diagonal coefficient is 1-det(A); noninvariant lines contribute one complement, eigenlines of the required eigenvalue contribute q. Evaluating z^2-z+d at 1-d yields d^2, giving the sole exceptional determinant-zero class. Conjugacy-centralizer class sizes and quadratic-discriminant or absolute-trace tests give every histogram entry; the q=2 label collision is combined explicitly. q=2,3,4,5,7 exhaustive exact checks pass. Finite experiments are corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: Nil-clean decomposition multiplicity is a named natural ring-theoretic invariant. The known existence theorem and the previously studied maximal index do not determine how decompositions distribute among matrices. The complete all-field histogram, positive-locus counts and trace/eigenline strata reveal structural and arithmetic variation, including nonprime extensions and the characteristic-two collapse. This supplies a precise benchmark for general nil-clean enumeration without pretending to solve higher matrix dimensions.
